intro: A woman in designer everything storms toward you, heels striking the ground like war drums.$A vein in her forehead has its own heartbeat.
speaker: The Mother
introDialogue: EXCUSE ME. Yes, YOU.$Did you or did you not run off with my little angel's {{mythicalName}}?!$My baby said it was left with some… some VAGRANT, and I have been looking for HOURS.$Do you have ANY idea who my husband is?! I will be speaking to the Pokémon League, the police chief, AND your manager!
title: The Mythical Mom
description: There is no reasoning with her. There is only the {{mythicalName}}, her lawyers, and the six-figure Pokémon she keeps for occasions exactly like this one.

1.label: Hand It Over
1.tooltip:
(-) Return the {{mythicalName}}
(+) Avoid an extremely difficult battle
1.selected: "Hmph. I suppose SOME people can follow basic instructions."$She snatches the Poké Ball without a word of thanks.

2.label: Refuse
2.tooltip:
(-) Fight her legendary team. Yes, all of them.
(+) Maybe keep the {{mythicalName}}… for a price
2.selected: Her eye twitches.$"Oh. OH. You want to do this the HARD way."$"Darlings! Mummy needs you!"

dontHaveIt: "You LOST it?! You absolute—"$She doesn't finish the sentence. The Poké Balls are already flying.
handedOver: {{mythicalName}} returns to its owner's family.$It gives you one last, ancient look.
buyBackPrompt: "Fine. FINE. You're clearly some kind of gifted delinquent.$If you want the {{mythicalName}} so badly… ₽{{price}}. CASH. That's what it's worth to make you go away."$Pay ₽{{price}} to keep {{mythicalName}}?
boughtBack: You hand over a truly obscene amount of money.$The {{mythicalName}} is yours now — legally, even.
cannotAfford: You turn out your pockets. She stares at the lint with visible disgust.$"Pathetic. Give it here."
reclaimed: She recalls the {{mythicalName}} and turns on her heel.$"The League WILL be hearing about this."
outro:
You can hear her complaining to someone on the phone
long after she's out of sight.
